description: Named, owner-approved exceptions to 'budgets only go down'. A commit that raises a budget carries the trailer 'Budget-Raise-Approved: <id>', where <id> is one of these rules or the hash of a commit that records the decision in docs/spring/phase1/decisions.md. The gates check that the trailer names a rule; the rule's conditions (its evidence, its exact delta) are the reviewer's to check. tools/template_budget_ratchet.py reads this file.

new-module-rule.summary: A new module's first caps: measured linked bytes and templates plus 10%, cited by receipt.

api-growth-rule.summary: An API module's cap may rise by a slice's measured delta of newly ported public API plus 10%, with before and after numbers. Not for engines.

jdk-leaf-rule.summary: A JDK package's budget rises by exactly the budget of a leaf it adds.

metric-rebaseline.summary: Once, a Phase 2 byte cap set in stripped-file bytes is re-baselined in loadable bytes at the measured value plus 10%, measuring the same executables in both metrics.
